description: Create a draft message in the Drafts folder without sending it. Returns the created draft, which can be changed with outlook_update_draft and sent with outlook_send_draft. It does not ask to confirm: a draft reaches nobody until it is sent. Calling it twice leaves two drafts. If Outlook does not answer in time, the connection drops, or a server error (5xx) comes back after the request was sent, the result has status "unknown": the write may well have gone through, so check before retrying — never resend blindly.

format.description: How the text is written: "text" (default, sent as typed), "markdown" (**bold**, _italic_, lists, [links](https://…), `code`, # headings, > quotes — sent as formatted HTML, and cheaper to write than HTML) or "html".

name: outlook_create_draft
